Package io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx

@NullMarked package io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx
LEGO Mindstorms RCX infrared remote control, brick commands, sensors, and firmware transfer.
  • Class
    Description
    RcxAudio
    An RCX brick's speaker, from RemoteRcx.getAudio().
    RcxBattery
    An RCX brick's batteries, from RemoteRcx.getBattery().
    RcxBrick
    The RCX's direct commands that answer back, the protocol under RemoteRcx's motors, sensors, display, sound and battery; use RemoteRcx in a program.
    RcxButtons
    An RCX brick's own View, Prgm and Run buttons, from RemoteRcx.getButtons().
    RcxChannel
    A Juno firmware channel of an RCX brick, or the original unchannelized broadcast.
    RcxFirmware
    Loads firmware into an RCX brick over infrared, as the LEGO IR tower does: the brick's boot ROM answers these four commands even when it has no firmware, which is the state it is in after its batteries were out (the display then shows program 0).
    RcxLcd
    An RCX brick's display, from RemoteRcx.getLcd().
    RcxLight
    A lamp connected to one of an RCX brick's motor outputs for tone activity indication.
    RcxLightSensor
    A light sensor plugged into an RCX input, e.g.
    RcxLink
    The RCX infrared framing: a message is 55 FF 00 followed by the opcode, its arguments and a checksum, each byte followed by its complement.
    RcxMotor
    One or more of an RCX brick's outputs, driven with direct commands over infrared: get them from RemoteRcx.getMotorA(), RemoteRcx.getMotorB() and RemoteRcx.getMotorC(), and combine them with RcxMotor.and(RcxMotor) so that several outputs start and stop in the same command, e.g. the two sides of a vehicle.
    RcxRegulatedDiagnostics
    Diagnostics read from the brick for a regulated pair, for tuning and floor tests: the control-cycle counter, which gives the brick's cycle rate, and how the wheel sync drives each side.
    RcxRegulatedDifferentialDrive
    A two-wheel RCX vehicle whose wheels are regulated on the brick: one RcxRegulatedPair on the firmware's only mapping (motor A with sensor 1 as the pair's left side, motor C with sensor 3 as its right side) driven by distance and heading through a RegulatedDifferentialDrive.
    RcxRegulatedMotor
    One side of an RcxRegulatedPair, as the RegulatedMotor contract: speed and acceleration are the pair's, a rotation of this side starts a movement in which the other side stays where it is, and the tachometer is this side's own.
    RcxRegulatedPair
    The A and C outputs of an RCX regulated by its own firmware, with their rotation sensors on inputs 1 and 3, driven as one pair: a movement sets both wheels' targets in a single infrared command, and the brick regulates both on its own between commands.
    RcxRegulatedState
    The state of a regulated RCX pair, as the firmware reports it, plus two states the host itself determines: RcxRegulatedState.EXTERNAL_OVERRIDE when a manual output command took the outputs back, and RcxRegulatedState.LINK_UNKNOWN when the outcome of the last command could not be resolved over the infrared link.
    RcxRemoteControl
    A receive-only LEGO Mindstorms RCX remote control, such as the 9738 handset.
    RcxRemoteControlButton
    One of the buttons exposed by the LEGO Mindstorms 9738 RCX remote control.
    RcxRotationSensor
    A rotation sensor plugged into an RCX input, e.g.
    RcxSensor
    One of an RCX brick's three sensor inputs: get it from RemoteRcx.getSensor1(), RemoteRcx.getSensor2() or RemoteRcx.getSensor3() and hand it to the sensor plugged into it, an RcxTouchSensor, RcxLightSensor, RcxTemperatureSensor or RcxRotationSensor, created once, at startup.
    RcxTemperatureSensor
    A temperature sensor plugged into an RCX input, e.g.
    RcxTouchSensor
    A touch sensor plugged into an RCX input, e.g.
    RemoteRcx
    A LEGO Mindstorms RCX brick reached over infrared: create it once, at startup, with the already-configured infrared RcxLink and a firmware channel; construction creates the brick's parts from the link — its motors (RemoteRcx.getMotorA(), RemoteRcx.getMotorB(), RemoteRcx.getMotorC()), its sensor inputs (RemoteRcx.getSensor1(), RemoteRcx.getSensor2(), RemoteRcx.getSensor3()), its display (RemoteRcx.getLcd()), its speaker (RemoteRcx.getAudio()), its batteries (RemoteRcx.getBattery()) and its firmware loader (RemoteRcx.getFirmware()).
